newsitem.title: UK: Siebe agrees supply deal with Electrolux.
newsitem.headline: Siebe agrees supply deal with Electrolux.

text.p: British diversified engineering group Siebe Plc said on Friday that it has agreed with Swedish appliance maker Electrolux to supply low temperature refrigerator and freezer controls.
Siebe said it will provide Electrolux with a major part of its cold controls requirement, valued at over 40 million stg over three years.
The controls will be manufactured worldwide by Siebe subsidiaries Ranco Controls and U.S.-based Robertshaw Controls, Siebe said in a statement.
By 1998, the contract will represent the supply of more than 12 million controls a year, it added.

"This agreement bodes well for future collaboration in serving emerging markets and for new product development," James F. Mueller, President and Chief Operating Officer for Siebe's temperature and appliance controls division, said.

Siebe, the world's largest manufacturer of domestic and commercial appliance controls, generated a pre-tax profit of 331.1 million stg on turnover of 2,599.1 million stg in the year ended at April 6, 1996.
